verdict.rationale: Three public CIPO pages (the office home, trademarks and patents pages) yielded readable server-side text without credentials, which shows the guidance surface is reachable. The captured text includes link titles, guidance descriptions and even a dynamic forecasted examination wait time. cipo-supp-2 also notes that public patent search is available keylessly beside the account-gated MyCIPO login. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that no bot wall or CAPTCHA appears for an identified agent user agent, evidence covering deeper guidance pages beyond the three landing pages, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent access.
